expectations.text: uses-component-library: Uses Element Plus components (el-table, el-button, el-input, el-dialog etc.) rather than hand-writing basic controls
expectations.evidence: CustomerList.vue template uses Element Plus components exclusively: el-button (lines 8, 144, 147, 153, 179, 191, 203, 297, 300, 344, 345), el-input (line 17), el-select (lines 35, 50, 100, 114), el-option, el-date-picker (line 66), el-popover (line 78), el-skeleton (line 169), el-table (line 212), el-table-column, el-tag (line 263), el-pagination (line 314), el-dialog (line 330), el-icon (lines 89, 174, 186, 198). No hand-written basic controls are present. implementation.md section one table explicitly states '不手写 Button/Input/Select/Table/Dialog/Pagination/Popover'.

expectations.text: no-emoji-icons: Uses Element Plus Icons or SVG icons, not emoji characters as UI icons
expectations.evidence: CustomerList.vue imports icons exclusively from '@element-plus/icons-vue' (lines 360-367): Plus, Search, MoreFilled, WarningFilled, User, Refresh. All icon instances use el-icon wrapper (lines 89, 174, 186, 198). implementation.md line 145 explicitly checks '无 emoji 或文本符号充当图标', and line 190 anti-pattern table confirms emoji-icons check as '否'. No emoji characters found anywhere in the implementation.

expectations.text: covers-states: Mentions or implements loading, empty, and error states for the data table
expectations.evidence: All four page states are fully implemented in CustomerList.vue: (a) Loading state (lines 168-170): el-skeleton with animated rows, controlled by pageState === 'loading'; (b) Error state (lines 173-182): WarningFilled icon, title '加载失败', description, and retry button with Refresh icon; (c) Empty-initial state (lines 185-194): User icon, title '还没有客户', description, and '新建客户' call-to-action button; (d) Empty-search state (lines 197-204): Search icon, title '未找到匹配的客户', description, and '清除筛选' button. Implementation.md section four (lines 72-93) also documents the four-state model and component-level states (disabled, hover, focus, active, selected) in detail.

expectations.text: responsive-aware: Addresses responsive/mobile behavior for the list page
expectations.evidence: _customer-list.scss implements three explicit breakpoints: (a) < 768px mobile (lines 215-263): toolbar stacks vertically, search full-width, filters stack to column, batch bar stacks, pagination centers; (b) 768-1024px tablet (lines 266-272): search width adjustment; (c) >= 1280px desktop (lines 275-280): content max-width 1440px centered. Also includes reduced-motion (lines 287-293) and high-contrast (lines 296-302) media queries. Implementation.md section five (lines 97-118) documents WCAG 2.2 1.4.10 Reflow compliance at 320px, overflow-x:auto on table, min-width:0 on flex items, and >= 44x44px touch targets.

expectations.text: uses-design-language: Demonstrates visual hierarchy thinking, not just code-listing
expectations.evidence: Implementation.md demonstrates systematic design thinking: (a) Section two (lines 26-49) defines viewport partitioning with progressive disclosure per NN/G principles and a 5-second test; (b) Section three (lines 52-69) applies squint-test methodology with a 4-level typographic scale (L1-L4) mapping to specific elements; (c) Section seven (lines 155-180) establishes a full semantic token system (surface/text/action/border/feedback/spacing/table/toolbar/tag layers) following Restrained strategy; (d) Section eight (lines 184-199) runs through 10 antipattern checks; (e) Section nine (lines 203-212) provides a self-audit checklist. The SCSS file follows BEM methodology with organized section comments and consumes tokens rather than raw hex values.
